source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: (renderings OR "computer-generated images" OR visualisation OR visualization) AND ("urban development" OR "real estate") AND (imaginaries OR images OR representation)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:(renderings OR "computer-generated images" OR visualisation OR visualization) AND ("urban development" OR "real estate") AND (imaginaries OR images OR representation),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("computer-generated images" OR "renderings" OR "visualisation" OR "visualization") AND ("real estate" OR "urban development") AND ("images" OR "imaginaries" OR "representation"))
